name: snRNA-seq of human retina - all cells
description: This atlas is an integrated collection of over 3.1 million nuclei, derived from single-nucleus RNA-seq data of the human retina. These retinal nuclei have been categorized into 10 major classes and more than 123 cell types and clusters.

labels.ontologyAssessment:
The Cell Ontology has two existing terms for two amacrine subclasses: GABAergic amacrine cells (CL:4030027) and Glycinergic amacrine cells (CL:4030028). They have specific markers: GABA-synthetic enzymes GAD1 and GAD2 for GABAergic amacrine cells; glycine transporter SLC6A9 for Glycinergic amacrine cells. However, the Cell Ontology does not have a term for amacrine cells expressing markers for both of these amacrine subclasses. 

The evidence for the new term is that around 10 amacrine clusters in the Human Retina Cell Atlas highly express markers for both GABAergic and Glycinergic amacrine cells as discussed in the following publications: 
https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-020-66092-9
https://doi.org/10.1523/JNEUROSCI.0471-20.2020

The new ontology term of GABAergic Glycinergic amacrine cells should be at the same level as GABAergic amacrine cells (CL:4030027) and Glycinergic amacrine cells (CL:4030028). Its parent term should be CL:0000561, and there is no synonym term for this new term.
